# Dashboard Activity Log Events

*Note: The Dashboard aggregates events generated by other modules. It generates very few events on its own.*

| Event Name | Triggering Actor | Payload Fields | Visible To Roles | Immutability Rule |
|------------|------------------|----------------|------------------|-------------------|
| `NOTIFICATION_DISMISSED` | `ROLE_CLIENT` | `notification_id`, `alert_type` | `ROLE_ADMIN` | Cannot be modified. |
| `DASHBOARD_VIEWED` | Any | `session_context` | `ROLE_ADMIN` | Read-only audit log. |
